summary_en: Yagi & Co. will repurchase up to 350,000 shares (1.43% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of 569.8 million yen on September 28, 2026 via off-hours trading (ToSTNeT-3) at the reference price of 1,628 yen per share.
title_en: Notice Regarding Repurchase of Treasury Shares via Off-Hours Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: Yagi & Co. announced on September 25, 2026 that it will repurchase treasury shares via off-hours trading (ToSTNeT-3) on September 28, 2026. The company will purchase up to 350,000 shares at the reference price of 1,628 yen per share set on September 25, 2026, for a maximum amount of 569.8 million yen. This represents 1.43% of the company's outstanding shares (excluding treasury shares), calculated from 24,427,952 shares as of August 31, 2026. The buy order will be placed before 8:45 a.m. on September 28, 2026 and will be valid only during the designated ToSTNeT-3 trading time. The company stated that the repurchase is conducted based on its medium-term management plan to pursue flexible capital policy and provide shareholder returns. Results of the repurchase will be announced after trading concludes on September 28, 2026. The company noted that market conditions may result in partial or no execution of the repurchase.
